name: covenant-v1
description: Covenant vault chip, interface v1. Once per epoch a kernel contract assembles the input bits from chain state, runs one beat, and routes one asset (the regime asset: the chain's native coin while the token is on its curve, the token itself after graduation) by the output bits, inside fixed limits. The four T_ shares must sum to 256, and so must the four V_ shares; a group that does not is treated as: all of it to the reserve. Amounts reach the chip only as log codes. Each chip defines its own state fields.

inputs.name: TAX
inputs.unit: base units of the regime asset
inputs.description: Fresh inflow of the regime asset recognised by this settle.

inputs.name: TAXCUM
inputs.unit: base units of the regime asset
inputs.description: Cumulative inflow in the current regime, this settle included. Restarts at graduation.

inputs.name: REV
inputs.unit: base units of the regime asset
inputs.description: Revenue since the last step. Kernel v1 always writes 0.

inputs.name: REVCUM
inputs.unit: base units of the regime asset
inputs.description: Cumulative revenue. Kernel v1 always writes 0.

inputs.name: RES
inputs.unit: base units of the regime asset
inputs.description: Reserve of the regime asset before this settle's routing.

inputs.name: ESC
inputs.unit: base units of the regime asset
inputs.description: Holder escrow. Kernel v1 always writes 0.

inputs.name: PROG
inputs.description: Curve progress: tokens sold times 255 divided by the sellable supply, rounded down, at most 254 while on the curve; 255 once graduated.

inputs.name: LOCK
inputs.description: Tokens locked or burned by the kernel times 255 divided by the total supply, rounded down.

inputs.name: DT
inputs.description: Epochs since the last persisted step.

inputs.name: GRAD
inputs.description: True once the token has graduated from the curve.

inputs.name: ZERO
inputs.description: Always 0. A chip must ignore these bits.

outputs.name: T_BUY
outputs.description: Share of fresh tax to buy-and-lock.

outputs.name: T_HOLD
outputs.description: Holder share of fresh tax. Kernel v1 adds it to the reserve.

outputs.name: V_BUY
outputs.description: Share of fresh revenue to buy-and-lock. Kernel v1 ignores it.

outputs.name: V_HOLD
outputs.description: Holder share of fresh revenue. Kernel v1 ignores it.

outputs.name: V_ALLOW
outputs.description: Allowance share of fresh revenue. Kernel v1 ignores it.

outputs.name: V_RES
outputs.description: Reserve share of fresh revenue. Kernel v1 ignores it.

outputs.name: REL
outputs.description: Share of the pre-settle reserve released into buy-and-lock.

outputs.name: CEIL
outputs.unit: base units of the regime asset
outputs.description: Ceiling on this settle's allowance amount.

outputs.name: MODE
outputs.description: Telemetry. Defined by each chip; the kernel does not act on it.

outputs.name: TIER
outputs.description: Telemetry. Defined by each chip; the kernel does not act on it.

outputs.name: FLAGS
outputs.description: Telemetry. Defined by each chip; the kernel does not act on it.

outputs.name: AUX
outputs.description: Telemetry. Defined by each chip; the kernel does not act on it.
